files.name: motion-prompt-009.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Easing" (イージング), one of the names in "Motion graphics moves".
Motion Prompt #009

What it is: Motion speeds up and slows down instead of moving at one speed
What the sample shows: Two squares cover the same distance in the same time: the top one at constant speed, the bottom one eased.
Spec:
- One round trip per 4.7 s. Two 62 px squares (radius 16) travel 316 px horizontally: out at 0.2–1.75 s (1.55 s), hold 0.8 s, back at 2.55–4.1 s.
- Top (constant): linear motion; shape and colour never change.
- Bottom (eased): cubic-bezier(.86, 0, .14, 1). Slow start, very fast middle, slow stop.
- The bottom square stretches horizontally up to 1.5× and flattens to 0.8× in proportion to speed (speed ÷ 3.6, clamped to 0–1).
- Behind it: 3 speed lines (up to 150 px × 0.8–1.25) and 4 ghost copies lagging 0.035 s each.
- Each rail shows 12 dots marking positions at equal time intervals (evenly spaced on top, bunched at both ends below).
When to use it: Use it on any move, scale or rotation so the motion accelerates and decelerates instead of looking mechanical.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/009.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/motion.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
